neighbours.label: The word ' one' when it describes a person or thing just named as a member of a group, right after a linking verb (is / was / became / remains / considered) or after a comma ('X is one of the ...', 'X, one of the ...', 'X is one who ...'); side trigger: ' or' straight after 'whether' ('whether or not'). Quiet for counting 'one' (one + noun, a number as an answer), 'the one that ...', clause-opening 'one of them' after 'and', and other uses of 'or' (either/or, sooner or later, A or B).
fire: Lisbon is one of the oldest cities in western Europe.
Marie Curie, one of the most famous scientists of her era, won two Nobel Prizes.
My grandfather was one who never complained about hard work.
The old oak remains one of the tallest trees in the county.
The novel became one of the best-selling books of the decade.
We still have not decided whether or not to take the train.
The violin solo is considered one of the hardest pieces in the repertoire.
She asked whether or not the museum was open on Mondays.
quiet: Lisbon has only one old cathedral left in the center.
Marie Curie won two Nobel Prizes during her famous career.
My grandfather never complained about hard work.
The old oak is the one that stands near the river.
The novel sold millions of copies over the decade.
We still have not decided between the train or the bus.
The violin solo is considered extremely hard to play.
